      "step": 1,
      "text": "A {{ing_01|fresh ham}} is cooked with {{ing_02|2 pounds of barley}} and {{ing_03|25 figs}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "When done skin, glaze the surface with a fire shovel full of glowing coals, spread {{ing_04|honey}} over it, or, what’s better: put it in the oven covered with {{ing_04|honey}}."
    },

      "text": "When it has a nice color, put in a sauce pan {{ing_05|raisin wine}}, {{ing_06|pepper}}, {{ing_07|a bunch of rue}} and {{ing_08|pure wine}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "When this [sauce] is done, pour half of it over the {{ing_01|ham}} and in the other half soak {{ing_09|specially made gingerbread}}."
    },
    {

      "text": "The remnant of the sauce after most of it is thoroughly soaked into the bread, add to the {{ing_01|ham}}."
